readerCopy.headline: Your plan may run straight into somebody else's.
readerCopy.body:
A deadline collides with another deadline. Someone wants a faster answer than you planned to give. A disagreement about timing can suddenly sound like a disagreement about the entire relationship. Both sides may feel reasonable and still be trying to use the same afternoon.

Jupiter opposing Mars makes each position feel larger and more urgent. Keep the conflict attached to the actual decision. Name who needs what, what can move, and what cannot. You may still disagree. At least the disagreement will be about the problem in front of you instead of every frustration that came before it.
doNotAssume: Do not assume hostility, breakup, legal conflict, or that either side is objectively right.
